nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner)
Address proposed to become the next owner (Owned.pendingOwner)
Minimum LINK amount in Juels required for a registration request
Mapping hash => PendingRequest(admin, balance) of unapproved registrations
Immutable LINK token interface used for refunds and funding
AutoApprovedConfig state controlling auto approval rate limits
KeeperRegistryBaseInterface used to register and fund upkeeps
Constant bytes4 selector of register() used for whitelisting calldata
Owned.transferOwnership(address _to) - owner starts ownership transfer
Owned.acceptOwnership() - pending owner completes transfer
Owned.onlyOwner modifier enforcing msg.sender == owner
register(...) external onlyLINK - creates or auto-approves an upkeep registration request
approve(...) external onlyOwner - manually approves a pending request and registers upkeep
cancel(bytes32 hash) external - deletes request and refunds LINK to msg.sender
setRegistrationConfig(...) external onlyOwner - updates auto-approve config and registry
getRegistrationConfig() view - returns current auto-approve configuration
getPendingRequest(bytes32 hash) view - returns admin and balance of a pending request
onTokenTransfer(...) external onlyLINK - LINK transferAndCall hook that delegatecalls into register
Private helper resetting the auto-approve window when block.number progressed
Private helper that registers the upkeep on the registry and funds it with LINK
Private helper checking whether the per-window approval limit is not exceeded
Private helper incrementing approvedInCurrentWindow in s_config
onlyLINK modifier enforcing msg.sender == address(LINK)
Modifier verifying calldata selector equals REGISTER_REQUEST_SELECTOR via assembly
Modifier verifying the LINK amount matches the calldata amount via assembly
msg.sender - externally controlled caller address used in access checks and refunds
address(this).delegatecall(data) inside onTokenTransfer executing arbitrary whitelisted call
Inline assembly mload(add(_data,32)) extracting the function selector
Inline assembly mload(add(data,228)) extracting the amount argument from raw calldata
LINK.transfer(msg.sender, request.balance) external refund call in cancel
LINK.transferAndCall(keeperRegistry, amount, upkeepId) funding external call in _approve
keeperRegistry.registerUpkeep(...) external call on attacker-configurable registry address
register() parameter name - display name of the upkeep
register() parameter upkeepContract - target of the upkeep
register() parameter gasLimit - gas provided to the target upkeep
register() parameter adminAddress - admin able to cancel the upkeep
register() parameter checkData - data passed when checking upkeep
register() parameter amount - LINK amount funding the request
cancel() parameter hash - request identifier to cancel
approve() parameter hash - request identifier to approve
onTokenTransfer() parameter amount - LINK sent via transferAndCall
onTokenTransfer() parameter data - payload delegatecalled into register
_approve() parameter amount - LINK amount forwarded to transferAndCall
setRegistrationConfig() parameter keeperRegistry - new registry address
setRegistrationConfig() parameter minLINKJuels - new minimum payment
transferOwnership() parameter _to - proposed new owner address
register() local hash = keccak256(abi.encode(upkeepContract, gasLimit, adminAddress, checkData))
register() local newBalance = s_pendingRequests[hash].balance.add(amount)
register() local copy of s_config in memory
cancel() local copy of s_pendingRequests[hash]
approve() local copy of s_pendingRequests[hash]
_approve() local upkeepId returned by registerUpkeep
_approve() local success flag of LINK.transferAndCall
onTokenTransfer() local success flag of the delegatecall
acceptOwnership() local oldOwner cached before reassignment
_resetWindowIfRequired() local blocksPassed = block.number - config.windowStart
